Arizona Golf Transportation: Elevate Your Round Before You Tee Off

Golf transportation in Scottsdale is simple: a foursome takes the 6-seat Luxury SUV at $125 per hour, two or three foursomes take the 14-seat Executive Sprinter at $145 per hour, and corporate outings run the 24- and 29-seat executive buses from $185 per hour. Arizona is a golf paradise, with hundreds of courses, playable weather most of the year, and desert scenery golfers travel across the world to see. Great golf transportation is about arriving relaxed and ready, enjoying the 19th hole without a designated driver, and keeping the group together from tee time to tee time.

Top Arizona Golf Destinations

Scottsdale

  • TPC Scottsdale (Stadium Course): home of the WM Phoenix Open and the famous 16th hole, in North Scottsdale near Hayden and Bell
  • Troon North (Monument and Pinnacle): desert golf at its finest among the boulders, north of the 101
  • Grayhawk (Raptor and Talon): player-friendly championship golf with an excellent practice facility, off Thompson Peak Parkway
  • We-Ko-Pa (Cholla and Saguaro): an underrated gem on Fort McDowell land, east of Fountain Hills

Paradise Valley and North Phoenix

  • The Phoenician: resort luxury at the foot of Camelback Mountain
  • Quintero: remote, quiet, bucket-list desert golf out past Lake Pleasant

Tucson (Day Trip)

  • Ventana Canyon: mountain golf with dramatic elevation, down in the Tucson foothills
  • Dove Mountain (Ritz-Carlton): a Jack Nicklaus design in immaculate condition

Golf Transportation Options

Luxury SUV (1-5 golfers)

Seats: 6 · Rate: $125/hour · Minimum: 4 hours
Single foursomes, daily rounds, airport transfers. Luggage and gear fit confirmed separately.

Executive Sprinter (5-14 golfers)

Seats: 14 · Rate: $145/hour · Minimum: 4 hours
Two or three foursomes, buddy trips, golf weekends. Forward-facing leather seating and a rear cargo area for clubs. Tell our reservations team how many players and bags are coming so we can confirm the load.

Mini Bus (24 Pax) (15-24 golfers)

Seats: 24 · Rate: $185/hour · Minimum: 4 hours
Corporate outings and society days. Minimal luggage, so this is the pick when clubs are already at the course. See the Mini Bus (24 Pax).

Executive Mini Coach (15-29 golfers)

Seats: 29 · Rate: $225/hour · Minimum: 4 hours
Tournaments and large outings. Luggage and gear fit confirmed separately. See the Executive Mini Coach.

56-Passenger Motorcoach (up to 56 golfers)

Seats: 56 · Rate: $325/hour · Minimum: 5 hours
The largest single vehicle we run, for the biggest outings. Luggage and gear fit confirmed separately. Fields larger than 56 run two vehicles, and the mini buses and Executive Mini Coach are the ones we have more than one of.

Sample Golf Trip Itineraries

The Scottsdale Buddy Trip (4 days, 3 rounds, 8 golfers)

Day 1 - Arrival: Executive Sprinter from PHX to the hotel, one-way transfer, $295. A transfer is flat within 15 road miles from pickup to drop-off; longer transfers are priced from the drive with the empty return included. Practice range, dinner in Old Town.

Day 2 - Premier Round: 6:30 AM pickup, 7:30 AM tee time at Troon North (Pinnacle), 12:30 PM back to the hotel. Six hours, $870, about $109 per golfer.

Day 3 - Double Header: 7:00 AM pickup, 8:00 AM We-Ko-Pa (Saguaro), lunch at the course, 2:30 PM We-Ko-Pa (Cholla), 7:00 PM return. Twelve hours bills 10, $1,450, about $181 per golfer.

Day 4 - Bucket List Finish: 8:00 AM pickup, 9:00 AM TPC Scottsdale (Stadium), 1:30 PM 19th hole, 3:00 PM to PHX. Eight hours bills 7, $1,015, about $127 per golfer.

The Corporate Outing (1 day, 16 golfers)

  • 7:00 AM: Executive Mini Coach collects the group from the hotel
  • 8:00 AM: Arrive Grayhawk (Raptor)
  • 8:30 AM: Shotgun start
  • 1:30 PM: Awards lunch at the clubhouse
  • 3:30 PM: Return to the hotel

Eight hours bills 7, $1,575, about $98 per golfer. Prefer two Executive Sprinters from two hotels? $1,015 each, $2,030 total.

The Father-Son Weekend (2 days, 2 golfers)

Day 1: Luxury SUV from PHX to Quintero, morning round, transfer to a Scottsdale hotel, dinner downtown. Eight hours bills 7, $875.
Day 2: Grayhawk, lunch at the clubhouse, transfer to PHX. Six hours, $750.

Golf Transportation Tips

Booking

  • Request a current quote for your date; availability varies in peak season (October-April)
  • Confirm tee times before booking transport
  • Share course names and addresses
  • Allow a 30-minute buffer for morning tee times

Day Of

  • Have clubs organized and ready
  • Confirm the pickup spot
  • Keep your chauffeur updated on pace of play
  • Plan 30-45 minutes after the round for the 19th hole

Club Handling

  • Your chauffeur loads and unloads
  • Count clubs before and after
  • Room for coolers and shoe bags, confirmed when you book

Golf Transportation FAQs

How many golf bags fit?
It depends on the vehicle and the group, so we confirm luggage and gear fit separately for every booking. Tell us the headcount and bag count and we will match the vehicle.

Should we book by the hour or for the day?
Everything is hourly. A 6-hour block covers a round and lunch; 7 or more hours earns a free hour, so a full day is cheaper per hour.

Can the chauffeur wait at the course?
Yes. The clock keeps running, but your ride is at the bag drop when you finish.

What about early tee times?
No problem. We do 5 AM pickups for dawn starts.

Do you serve courses outside Phoenix?
Yes. Tucson, Sedona, Flagstaff. Long days earn free hours.

Can we drink on the way back?
Passengers 21 and over can. Arizona's open-container law exempts passengers in a vehicle for hire such as a party bus or limousine (A.R.S. § 4-251). BYOB, and the driver never drinks; read the full explainer.
